setting_en: You need to get to Gyeongbokgung Palace and ask a station attendant for help.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: The ticket gates are crowded. You walk up to the help desk.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.en: Excuse me. How do I get to Gyeongbokgung?
lines.hints_en: Get attention politely (실례합니다) and ask how to go: ~에 어떻게 가요?

lines.speaker: attendant
lines.en: Take Line 1 and transfer to Line 3 at Jongno 3-ga.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.hints_en: Ask how many stops: 몇 (how many) + 정거장 (stops) + 이에요?

lines.speaker: attendant
lines.en: Six stops in total. Get off at Gyeongbokgung Station.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.hints_en: Thank them warmly in formal polite speech.

lines.speaker: attendant
lines.en: You're welcome. Have a great trip!

review_targets.note: Polite way to get a stranger's attention.
